description: Current Bike Availability by Station (archived) is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Healthy Ride. A structured data feed that provides current bike availability at Healthy Ride stations in Pittsburgh. The Healthy Ride system was replaced by POGOH in May 2022. Data for the POGOH system may be found here:. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Healthy Ride. Its tags are archived, bikeshare, real-time, transportation. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XML. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
